title: Opt-in NVIDIA NIM generator on benchmark_v1 1.2.0
resource_note: Calls NVIDIA NIM (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b) through the OpenAI-compatible HTTP API and scores claims with DeBERTa NLI. Requires NVIDIA_API_KEY. There is no mock fallback if the LLM call fails.
